video_title: The King of New York, Jalen Brunson, Joins the Tam Fam!

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his father's role in his daily development
quotes.excerpt: He tells me how it is every single day. He says the things that I need to hear.
quotes.quote: He tells me how it is every single day. He says the things that I need to hear every single day, not just what I want to hear.

quotes.speaker: Tamron Hall
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Brunson's personality at home versus on the basketball court
quotes.excerpt: Off the court at home, he's the biggest clown in the house.

text_blocks.speaker: Rick Brunson
text_blocks.text: Off the court at home, he's the biggest clown in the house.

text_blocks.speaker: Tamron Hall
text_blocks.text: He's the biggest clown? He's funny?

text_blocks.speaker: Rick Brunson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he's going to be really funny.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of family trust in his career
quotes.excerpt: Everything that they've said to me growing up has eventually come true.
quotes.quote: Trust means the world to me. I feel like everything that they've said to me growing up has eventually come true. It's been great throughout this entire experience of winning and doing all that stuff. But the best part about it is that they've been the same, I've been the same. Nothing's really changed my family dynamic part, so I just love everything about it.

quotes.speaker: Sandra Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Brunson on her long-standing role in Jalen's career management
quotes.excerpt: I've been the president for his whole career.
quotes.quote: I've been the president for his whole career.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on prioritizing his NBA job over extracurricular opportunities
quotes.excerpt: The biggest focus is my job, and while I've been doing a lot, that's been my main focus.
quotes.quote: The biggest focus is my job, and while I've been doing a lot, that's been my main focus every single day, making sure that's taken care of first. And then I get to do all the extracurricular stuff. I'm still doing what I have to do every single day.
